changes.title: UIMSD Columns popup stays responsive to repeated touches
changes.text: UIMSD now defers rebuilding the table behind open modal windows so a column choice cannot put fresh table pointer controls above the still-open Columns picker. Multiple checkboxes remain selectable; the table refreshes after Done or close.

changes.title: Privacy-safe groundwork for UIMSD charts
changes.text: An immutable bounded chart-series model is derived only from authorized grouped UIMSD query results, retaining original scope, uncertainty/provenance and group order. No actual chart window or gameplay changes yet.

changes.title: Regression checks for multi-selection and chart provenance
changes.text: Core chart foundation previously passed 1895 tests. A new API34 native touch test taps two Columns switches in succession, verifies modal priority and post-close refresh; all prior native tests remain required.

changes.title: Request paired private TEST287 builds
changes.text: Private matched developer and regular-player APKs built against exact previously verified TEST286 signing, history and application identity; no public release, staging or tester distribution.
